reviewer: Prototype reviewer (acting as implementation lead; not legal counsel)
scope: Declarations-page rules for the FL HO-3 sample. Out-of-scope rules are kept for the rules library but not approved for this document.

FL_DECLARATIONS_HURRICANE_DEDUCTIBLE_DIS.note: Statute gives no mechanical definition of 'prominently'. The carrier's current form prints the amount at 13.7pt bold against 11.4pt body text; treat 'larger and bold than body text' as the working interpretation, pending legal confirmation.

FL_DECLARATIONS_HURRICANE_PREMIUM_SEPARA.note: Hurricane and non-hurricane portions are separate labeled amounts on the current form.

FL_DECLARATIONS_OTHER_DEDUCTIBLES_INDICA.note: AOP and sinkhole deductibles map to document fields. Flood deductible only applies when flood coverage is provided (not on this policy); no product field exists for other special deductibles.

FL_DECLARATIONS_AGENT_SIGNATURE.note: Model mapped 'signed by a Florida licensed agent' to agent name and license number. A name is not a countersignature; how countersignature is satisfied (wet, electronic, facsimile) is a carrier process question.
add_unresolved: agent countersignature is not represented in the document model

FL_DECLARATIONS_PHONE_NUMBER_NOTICE.note: 627.4131 requires the insurer's number and its purpose (inquiries, complaints). The agent phone does not satisfy it. The checklist allows it elsewhere, e.g. the policy jacket.
add_unresolved: insurer inquiry/complaint phone number and purpose statement not in document model

FL_DECLARATIONS_FLOOD_EXCLUSION_STATEMEN.note: Applies (HO-3, no flood coverage). The DFS sample page does not show it; it may be on another page of the issued packet. Do not auto-insert regulatory language; carrier legal confirms placement and text.

FL_DECLARATIONS_HURRICANE_DEDUCTIBLE_STA.note: Statute says 'on its face'. Not on the DFS sample page. Same handling as the flood statement.

FL_DECLARATIONS_SINKHOLE_EXCLUSION_STATE.note: Derived applicability: sinkhole shows 'Not Included' and no sinkhole element exists. Not on the DFS sample page. Same handling as the flood statement.

FL_DECLARATIONS_LAW_AND_ORDINANCE_STATEM.note: Statute says 'with the policy documents'; checklist says 'typically on declarations page'. Kept as policy_form until the carrier confirms placement.

FL_DECLARATIONS_LEGISLATIVE_DISCOUNTS.note: Date-bounded (10/1/24 to 9/30/25). Not applicable to the 2020 sample policy; would apply to policies in that window. The three discounts are named through concept qualifiers so an unrelated discount row (roof update, wind mitigation) does not satisfy the rule.

FL_DECLARATIONS_ROOF_DEDUCTIBLE_DISPLAY.note: Applicability unknown: the product model has no roof deductible field. Product question, not a template question.

FL_DECLARATIONS_HURRICANE_DEDUCTIBLE_INF.note: Applicability unknown: no inflation guard element or field in policy data.

FL_DECLARATIONS_FLOOD_DEDUCTIBLE_LIMITS_.note: Not applicable to this policy (no flood coverage). No document fields exist yet for flood limits/deductible.
